app.compareNote: Sim DPS is the newest MythicSim run for each spec: 2-minute single-target fight, reference gear, no trinkets. Population is from beta samples and will change at launch.
app.dungeonNote: Enter your level to highlight dungeons around it. Dungeon XP is far below Classic, so run them for gear and quests.
facts: Included with any WoW subscription or Game Time. The Skyborne race needs an upgrade pack.
Launch 4 November at 11pm UK. No raids at launch: Barrow Deeps (10), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) open 9 December.
Two more raids are planned for spring 2027 and a revamped classic raid plus a new one for summer 2027. Molten Core isn't on the announced schedule.
Level cap 60. No flying and no level scaling. No traditional realms.
Hardcore won't be available at launch.
World buffs don't work in Forever raids.
Dungeon XP is far below Classic, so quest in the open world and run dungeons for gear.
Wands and Auto Shot need you to stand still for 0.5 sec before firing.
The beta closed on 23 October and nothing from it carries over. Early name reservation for upgrade-pack owners runs until 3 November; everyone else creates characters at launch.
Blizzard says some layering will remain at launch. It has fixed groups being split on boats and zeppelins and when entering or leaving capital cities (reported by GameSpot, 23 October).
app.gearNote: Levelling picks come from the level-30 beta lists. Trinket gains are MythicSim results and differ by spec. Items marked unverified are level-60 loot whose Forever drop tables aren't confirmed yet (the beta stops at 30). "Also wanted by" shows which of your other classes would compete for the same item.
raidFacts: Onyxia's Lair needs the Drakefire Amulet, earned per character and only needed in your bags (Blizzard raid overview, 20 October). The quest chain matches Classic. Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit have no attunement chain.
All raids are currently planned to reset each week (Blizzard raid overview, 20 October).
Every raid boss drops a chase item. Every class gets a new tier set, and the first new legendary is tied to the Hyjal Summit tier.

Crafted tier pieces are Bind on Equip and you can wear only one at launch; a Guardians of Hyjal reputation reward raises that to two, enough for the 2-piece bonus. Each needs 3 Malleable Essence of Nature, which only comes from disenchanting Barrow Deeps or Hyjal Summit items.
World buffs don't work in Forever raids. Four new Natural flasks work only in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit and Barrow Deeps.
Eight group buffs became raid-wide on 15 October (Battle Shout, Trueshot Aura, several totems, Moonkin Aura for spell crit, Leader of the Pack).
An epic raid item unlocks its transmog only for the player who loots it.
About 8,000 items still ship without stats, including most Tier 1 and Tier 2 pieces and later dungeon loot, so level-60 gear lists are educated guesses until launch.

app.tierNote: MythicSim reference builds, level 60, 2-minute single-target fight, in MythicSim's default "Best of each spec" view (22 specs). The DPS shown is MythicSim's no-trinket figure; the rank follows MythicSim's order, which uses its with-trinkets headline number, so a spec can sit above one with slightly higher DPS here (Arcane above Beast Mastery). rules: A basic campfire holds 3 features, Journeyman 5, Expert 10.
Placing any feature starts a 60-minute cooldown on all your features. The Field Guide Legacy perk cuts it to 45 minutes.
Upgraded features come from blueprints at 140 and 300 skill.
Every feature needs a campfire nearby.
camping.summary: Build a campfire with Cooking, then place profession features around it. Sit or craft nearby for about a minute to get hour-long buffs that scale with your level. Learn it from the Camping 101 quest in your starting zone around level 5–6.

items: Normal: world PvP only when both players opt in. Easiest for mixed friend groups.
PvP: contested zones stay dangerous and levelling there is slower. One faction per account on this ruleset, with faction-balance systems like Season of Discovery.
Roleplaying: Normal rules with an RP community.
Roleplay-PvP: Blizzard confirmed on 22 Oct that it will be added for launch, and is working to let you reserve names on it from 27 October.
Hardcore: after launch, no date yet. Fully closed off; a dead character can transfer out.
Battlegrounds are the only place rulesets mix.
cards.title: Choosing a ruleset

launch.summary: Alliance, Normal ruleset, solo until you find a guild at 60. Nobody has timed 1–60 in Forever yet (the beta stopped at 30); estimates for a first character run 100–130 hours played. At about 30 hours a week that's 60 around 29 November, leaving roughly ten days of pre-raid prep before raids open on 9 December. Raids reset weekly, so arriving a week or two later costs little. Night Elf is currently the top Shadow race in MythicSim's race sims (812.4 DPS; every race is within 0.8%).
launch.title: Your plan: Night Elf Shadow Priest

phases.title: Before launch
phases.summary: Settle the things that are awkward to change later.

items.text: Have your Night Elf name ready, plus two backups.
items.why: Names are two-part and unique across Europe. With an upgrade pack you can reserve until 3 November; otherwise create it at launch.

items.text: Install Questie, Details!, Talents Forever and Forever Dungeon Journal, then update them on launch day.
items.why: See the addon list below for each one's Forever status.

items.text: Load the levelling Legacy build in the planner below.
items.why: Thrill of Adventure 5, Well Rested 5, Talented 5, Gourmand 1. The tree opens when you reach 25.

items.text: Commit to Tailoring + Enchanting.
items.why: No vendor sells wands at launch, so making your own is the biggest early speed-up. Later, Tailoring makes crafted tier pieces and Enchanting turns raid drops into Malleable Essence.

items.text: Start reading guild adverts for Alliance, Normal, Europe.
items.why: Blizzard's WoW Forever forums (Community Connections), EU Discords and GuildOrder. Raid rosters fill before 9 December.

phases.title: Launch night: Teldrassil
phases.summary: Launch is 11pm UK on Wednesday 4 November. Expect queues and crowded starting zones.

items.text: From level 4, open with Shadow Word: Pain.
items.why: It tags a mob instantly when other players are competing for it.

items.text: Pick up the Camping 101 quest around level 5–6.
items.why: It unlocks your campfire, which later holds the Spinning Wheel and Loom some Tailoring patterns need.

items.text: Train Tailoring and Enchanting and make a Lesser Magic Wand at 5.
items.why: The wand is most of your damage until 40.

items.text: Train Starshards at 10 along with Mind Blast.
items.why: Your first Night Elf Priest spell: Arcane damage over 6 sec, much stronger in Forever, 30 sec cooldown.

phases.title: Wand and Spirit Tap
phases.summary: Discipline/Shadow hybrid. Darkshore and Ashenvale on the Night Elf side, or cross to Westfall, Loch Modan, Redridge, Duskwood and Wetlands.

items.text: Talents: 2 points Wand Specialization, then Spirit Tap 5/5 and Improved Shadow Word: Pain 2/2.
items.why: Spirit Tap after kills means almost no drinking.

items.text: Make a Greater Magic Wand at 13.
items.why: About 50% more damage than the Lesser Magic Wand. Wands no longer scale with spell power, so the wand itself is your damage.

items.text: Run Blackfathom Deeps for the Gravestone Scepter quest wand (18–25).
items.why: It boosts Shadow Word: Pain. Dungeon XP is low in Forever, so run dungeons for gear and quests.

items.text: At 20, train Devouring Plague, Fear Ward and Elune's Grace.
items.why: Devouring Plague and Fear Ward are baseline for every Priest in Forever. Fear Ward was Dwarf-only in Classic, so it's a selling point to raid guilds.

items.text: At 25, spend your Legacy points.
items.why: Your first character to 25 unlocks the account-wide Legacy tree.

items.text: End each session in an inn or a capital city.
items.why: Rested XP doubles the XP from kills, and Well Rested in Legacy builds it up 20% faster.

phases.title: Hybrid to 40
phases.summary: Stay hybrid for solo questing. Scarlet Monastery and Razorfen Kraul for the level-30 gear picks.

items.text: Collect Stygian Bone Amulet and Swinetusk Shank (Razorfen Kraul), Blighted Leggings (Scarlet Monastery Graveyard) and Reedknot Ring (quest).
items.why: The level-30 Shadow picks on the Gear tab.

items.text: Train Shadow Word: Death at 32.
items.why: Baseline in Forever. Its backlash costs 30% of your max health if the target survives (10% before the 30 Oct hotfix).

items.text: Buy 'of Shadow Wrath' greens on the Auction House.
items.why: They dominate early Shadow gear lists.

items.text: Try Riverglades, the new zone, from 35.
items.why: New Forever content alongside Arathi, Desolace and Stranglethorn.

phases.title: Shadowform
phases.summary: Respec into full Shadow at 40. Mind Flay now does most of the work.

items.text: Respec to full Shadow at 40 and train Shadowform.
items.why: Respecs are cheap. Shadowform halves the Mana cost of Shadow spells and doubles their crit bonus.

items.text: Get the Master Hunter's Wand from the Big Game Hunter chain in Stranglethorn.
items.why: Level 43 elite quest. Keep a good wand for finishing even after Shadowform.

items.text: Once you have about 40–50 spell power, value Spirit as highly as spell power.
items.why: Spirit Tap doubles your Spirit after kills.

phases.title: Push to 60
phases.summary: The longest stretch: roughly 40% of the hours to 60. Un'Goro, Felwood, Burning Steppes, Winterspring and the Plaguelands. Start the Onyxia chain while you level; its early quests give XP and save time at 60.

items.text: Start the Onyxia chain: Dragonkin Menace from Helendis Riverhorn in Burning Steppes (level 48).
items.why: Then The True Masters (six quests across Lakeshire, Stormwind Keep and Morgan's Vigil). Most of it is outdoor questing.

items.text: In Blackrock Depths, free Marshal Windsor: the Prison Cell Key from High Interrogator Gerstahn, then Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge for A Shred of Hope, then Jail Break!
items.why: Usually two BRD runs. Blackrock Depths also drops early pre-raid gear.

items.text: Finish The Great Masquerade in Stormwind and pick up The Dragon's Eye.
items.why: The Dragon's Eye takes you to Winterspring (Haleh in Classic; Blizzard hasn't named the Forever NPC).

items.text: Keep Tailoring and Enchanting levelled as you go.
items.why: Crafted tier pieces and disenchanting raid loot both need high skill on 9 December.

phases.title: Level 60 to raid night
phases.summary: About ten days for the Drakefire Amulet, pre-raid gear, consumables and a guild. Do the Upper Blackrock Spire runs first: the amulet and the best trinket come from the same boss. Level-60 loot is unconfirmed until players see it, so check the Gear tab's Pre-raid 60 filter as it updates.

items.text: Kill General Drakkisath in Upper Blackrock Spire to finish the Drakefire Amulet.
items.why: Needed in your bags for Onyxia. Whether Forever still needs the Seal of Ascension to enter UBRS is unconfirmed.

items.text: Farm the Blackrock Spire trinkets: Draconic Infused Emblem (Drakkisath, +2.16%) and Briarwood Reed (Jed Runewatcher, +1.81%).
items.why: The Emblem drops from the same boss as your amulet. Skip Talisman of Ephemeral Power: Molten Core isn't in Forever.

items.text: Work through the pre-raid list: Don Mauricio's Band (Scholomance), Bracers of the Eclipse and Fluctuating Cloak (Dire Maul West), Amulet of the Redeemed and Cape of the Black Baron (Stratholme), the Ironweave set.
items.why: Classic staples; Forever drop tables aren't confirmed yet. Spell hit first for a raid boss three levels higher.

items.text: Start Guardians of Hyjal reputation.
items.why: A reward raises the crafted tier limit from one piece to two, enough for the 2-piece bonus.

items.text: Stock raid consumables and gold for repairs.
items.why: Elixir of Shadow Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Brilliant Wizard Oil, Mageblood or Major Mana Potions, Demonic Runes, spell damage food. World buffs don't work in Forever raids.

items.text: Join a raiding guild by early December.
items.why: Pitch yourself as Shadow with baseline Fear Ward who can heal in a pinch. Ask for Blessing of Salvation: Shadow has no threat reduction talent now.

phases.title: Raids open
phases.summary: Barrow Deeps (10), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) all open on 9 December and reset weekly.

items.text: Raid Barrow Deeps or Hyjal Summit with your guild, and Onyxia once your amulet is done.
items.why: A 10-player raid is the easiest one to get a spot in as a new member.

items.text: Collect Raiments of Conviction, the Shadow tier set.
items.why: 2-piece +1% hit. Its 5-piece predates the Devouring Plague rework and will probably change.

items.text: Upload your raids to Warcraft Logs if it supports Forever.
items.why: Real logs show how Shadow performs better than sims do. The Codex will add them as a source when they exist.

items.text: Disenchant unneeded raid drops for Malleable Essence of Nature.
items.why: Each crafted tier piece needs 3.

legacy.summary: Every character spends up to 16 points across three trees. Points come from 65 account-wide challenges, including Novice, Experienced and Master for each class, so levelling one class helps the others. Legacy unlocks when your first character reaches level 25. Your plan is saved on this device for each class.
